description: This file is a shell script used for testing colorized remote message output in a git environment. It defines various test scenarios to ensure that remote messages are correctly colorized and formatted when pushed to a remote repository, utilizing a testing library and git commands.

methods.name: test_hook
methods.description: Sets up or tears down the test environment, used here for setup operations.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, with a description and a shell command sequence.

methods.name: test_decode_color
methods.description: Decodes colorized output into a readable format for verification.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a commit with specified message and content in the test repository.
